title: Timestral
author: Adrien Petralia, Alexandre Gavaudan, Artjom Joosen, Etienne Goffinet et al.

summary: , a family of four time series foundation models for probabilistic forecasting, with 5M, 28M, 123M, and 209M parameters. Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric.
takeaways: Weights for all four models are available on Hugging Face and inference code on GitHub.
This report describes the model design and its benchmark results.
Timestral sets a new state of the art on GIFT-Eval, TIME, and fev-bench, where Timestral-209M and Timestral-123M take the top two places on every metric.
